    Read and write configuration files

    Source: R/config-io.R
    gk_write_config.Rd

    gk_write_config() writes a configuration as pretty-printed canonical JSON (sorted keys) following inst/schema/gatekeepr-config-1.0.0.schema.json. gk_read_config() parses a file with jsonlite (no code is evaluated), rebuilds the configuration through the constructors and aborts with a gatekeepr_error_config listing every failed check.

    Usage

    gk_write_config(config, path)

gk_read_config(path)

    Arguments

    config

    A gk_config().

    path

    File path.

    Value

    gk_write_config() returns config invisibly; gk_read_config() returns a gk_config.

    See also

    Other configuration: gk_config(), gk_config_hash(), gk_hierarchy(), gk_min_support(), gk_panel(), gk_signal_policy(), gk_validate_config(), hierarchy-elements

    Examples

    path <- tempfile(fileext = ".json")
gk_write_config(gk_example_config(), path)
cfg <- gk_read_config(path)
identical(gk_config_hash(cfg), gk_config_hash(gk_example_config()))
#> [1] TRUE
unlink(path)
